title: Beyond the 956: Efraín Rosas León, Mexican actor known as “El Gallo,” dies at 56
excerpt: Efraín Rosas León, the Mexican actor known as “El Gallo” and best remembered as “el Músculos” in Hasta que el dinero nos separe, died November 12, 2026, at 56.
content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Efraín Rosas León, the Mexican film and television actor known to colleagues and fans as “El Gallo,” has died at 56.

Rosas León died Thursday, November 12, 2026, the National Actors Association (ANDA) and the National Association of Interpreters (ANDI) announced. No official cause of death has been disclosed.

He was best remembered as “el Músculos,” the brash friend of Pedro Fernández’s character in the Televisa telenovela Hasta que el dinero nos separe. He also appeared in Eugenio Derbez’s La Familia P.Luche and the series Camelia la Texana, and in the films Tenemos la carne, Todas las pecas del mundo and Párvulos: Hijos del Apocalipsis.

Colleagues including Lalo España and Alejandro Tomassi mourned his death, remembering him as a loyal friend and a dedicated performer.

Rest in Peace, Efraín Rosas León.

Sources: ANDA; ANDI; TVyNovelas; N+.
